result.rationale: The new handler in apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts calls `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")` and `JSON.parse(...)` with no try/catch, and also uses `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse` (not safeParse). Malformed input or a decryption failure throws, producing an unhandled 500 instead of a 4xx client error. This is verifiable directly in the diff and is a real error-handling defect in newly added code, though minor in severity.
